text: This landing defines --border-color-box-info in both normal and forced-color branches, then uses that name in the encryption card and cross-user update warning. The card also uses the existing info-box background token. Fixed source retains a forced-color currentColor border/transparent background, while the selected card has its own later override. These are exact declaration/consumer relationships; no rendered contrast or native accessibility result was measured.
title: The info-box border rename is paired across common color branches and its two changed consumers
